reviews.title: Wonderful headset, really
reviews.comment: The quality of Razer products astounds to me with how great they are for their prices. When shopping for a new headset, I had little to no prior knowledge to understanding which gaming brands were good for my money. I bought these with the intent of having headphones with a microphone that I could mute with the click of a button and last me a while. I was quite skeptical at first, but this exceeded my expectations. I’d say their headsets fall between the medium for its price, but I also say they go beyond for its quality. I’ve gotten these a while ago, having kept up with them since 2024. These can rest on your head and ears comfortably and do not cause any discomfort even when worn for prolonged periods of time. The quality of sound and its output is great. It is not underwhelming at all, having a scroll wheel to adjust the volume directly from your headset. Along with its input, the microphone is amazing. I frequently talk using the microphone attached with no concern for “bad” or choppy quality, I’ve seen some reviews with some mixed feelings about the plastic which the headsets use, having its quality compromised for it to be light weight. I have found no issues with the material used and found them comfortable to use long term. These are definitely worth the purchase with their outstanding performance, long-lasting comfortability and reasonable price point. While others may be concerned for parts of its build, my experience with it has been entirely positive. I would recommend these to anybody looking for a solid and lightweight headset for gaming!
reviews.author: Linh Luu

reviews.title: Great headset!
reviews.comment: These are wired over-ear headphones that focus more on passive noise isolation than active noise canceling. The ear cups fit snugly around the ears, which helps reduce outside noise without any electronics involved. This makes them useful in situations where you don’t want to worry about batteries or charging. Sound quality is solid for everyday listening. Bass is present but not overpowering, mids are clear, and vocals come through cleanly. They perform well for watching videos, casual music listening, and computer use. The wired connection is stable with no lag, which is helpful for video editing or streaming. Comfort is good for extended use. Padding is soft enough that it doesn’t cause pressure quickly, though long sessions may still require short breaks. Build quality feels decent for the price, with adjustable sizing that accommodates different head shapes. Overall, these are dependable wired headphones that do what they’re supposed to do without unnecessary features. Theres no need to worry about Battery life becuase its wired. Its fully compatible with ANY device, HOWEVER you need to make a razer ID in order to unlock the free 7.1 surround sound, whitch is a complicated process.
